(ESA 2024) Choose the suitable adjectives to make the text coherent.

THE ROUTINE OF A MODEL PLATOON SERGEANT

The routine of a model platoon sergeant, a crucial figure in a military unit, is ____ of diverse responsibilities and challenges. While they may be ____ at maintaining discipline, they are never ____ with their subordinates. In fact, they understand the importance of being ____ to privates and corporals within the unit.
Platoon Sergeants are committed to the growth and well-being of their team. They are ____ in their soldiers' professional development, offering guidance and mentorship. They are also devoted to the mission of the unit. Like anyone else, platoon sergeants sometimes feel ____ with the demands of their role. However, their commitment remains firm, as they are aware that their actions can influence the success or failure of a mission. If any mistakes occur, they are ____ about the consequences and take responsibility for leading their team to learn and improve. The role of a platoon sergeant is ____ from other ranks, requiring strong leadership. While they have moments of fear or hesitation, they do not let it overcome them. They perform their duties with diligence, always aware of the impact on their unit's morale and performance.

subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) CERTA, como os comentários a seguir comprovam:

no signs of danger → uso correto de "no" como adjetivo indefinido, qualificando "signs".

"I see no signs of danger."

🔁 Não vejo sinais de perigo.

nothing bad happens → "nothing" como pronome indefinido sujeito da oração.

"I hope nothing bad happens."

🔁 Espero que nada de ruim aconteça.

any situation → "any" como adjetivo indefinido para indicar qualquer situação, especialmente em contexto hipotético.

"We’re ready for any situation."

🔁 Estamos prontos para qualquer situação.

something moving → "something" como pronome indefinido indicando uma coisa indefinida percebida no escuro.

"There is something moving."

🔁 Tem algo se movendo.

Somebody is coming → "somebody" como sujeito da oração.

"Somebody is coming toward us."

🔁 Alguém está vindo.

Is anybody there? → "anybody" em frase interrogativa, uso adequado.

"Is anybody there?"

🔁 Tem alguém aí?

nobody poses a threat → "nobody" como sujeito da oração com sentido negativo, sem necessidade de "not".

"Make sure nobody poses a threat."

🔁 Certifique-se de que ninguém represente ameaça.
